notes.title: Major Update with Fixes, Achievements and Steam Cards!
notes.content:
After changing teams twice since release, we finally managed to make a major update.


[b]*Fixed the "White Screen of Death"[/b] and the [b]"Loading from Hell"[/b] that were prevent the game from running in some computers.

[b]*Changed the requirements[/b]. The game no longer needs Internet Explorer or .Net Framework installed in order to run.

* Added [b]Steam Cards[/b]

* Added [b] Story Oriented Steam Achievements[/b]

*Fixed some "storytelling bugs"

Enjoy

tags.bug: *Fixed the "White Screen of Death" and the "Loading from Hell" that were prevent the game from running in some computers.
